# E10 review / learner record — template

Status: blank template; not acceptance evidence. Copy to `docs/reviews/` and replace placeholders with observed results. Omit irrelevant fields with a reason, not an invented pass.

- Record ID:
- Reviewer/learner pseudonym and role:
- Date and reviewed commit:
- Independent of implementation author? Explain involvement:
- Objective IDs / exact destination anchors:
- Review type: technical / editorial / learner trial / accessibility / execution:
- Prior knowledge and environment (browser/device or locked runtime/hardware):
- Original feedback link, if applicable:

## Technical/editorial rubric

Score 0–3; cite evidence for every score below 3. Proposed pass: 24/30 or more, every criterion at least 2, no unresolved factual/executable error.

| Criterion | Score | Evidence / required revision |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Definition and motivation | | |
| Prerequisite accessibility | | |
| Mechanism and mathematics | | |
| Worked example | | |
| Implementation or contextual decision activity | | |
| Visual clarity and interpretation | | |
| Uses, alternatives and limits | | |
| Exercises, feedback and transfer | | |
| Source traceability | | |
| Accessibility and navigation | | |

For each objective: record required coverage dimensions separately, source/equation checks, affected execution record paths and declared scope. Cite assertions, masks, split invariants, metrics and artifact checks actually inspected. Record commands and failures, not just “tests passed.”

## Decision and follow-up

- Findings and severity, with exact locations:
- Required revisions / unresolved questions:
- Retest revision, task and observed result:
- Accepted objective IDs and justification (leave empty until accepted):
- Deferred/failed objective IDs and reasons:
- Reviewer confirmation and evidence link:

Do not treat learner satisfaction as technical acceptance, or a run on one device as execution on another. Update canonical review/coverage data only for the scope supported by this record.
